target.title: fix(ollama): fall back when native streams end early
target.body:
Closes #100460.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a native Ollama chat stream ending before its final response could dead-end a configured model fallback chain.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Ollama plugin now classifies only its exact incomplete-stream error as `server_error` for both local Ollama and Ollama Cloud. The stream producer and provider classifier share one constant, so this vendor-specific rule stays in the provider boundary and unrelated Ollama errors remain unclassified.

## User Impact

Users with model fallbacks configured can advance to the next candidate when Ollama closes an incomplete native stream instead of receiving a terminal request failure.

## Evidence

- Exact head: `cb6b626c1537697fa97a18c472c76632b58574a1`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/ollama/index.test.ts extensions/ollama/src/stream-runtime.test.ts` - 2 files, 163 tests passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` passed.
- Exact-head hosted CI run `28763002390` passed all selected jobs.
- Fresh branch AutoReview reported no actionable findings and rated the patch correct with 0.86 confidence.
- The maintainer-authored changelog note accurately describes the fallback behavior and credits @TurboTheTurtle.
- Upstream `ollama/ollama@964ea42` defines `ChatResponse.Done` as the completion signal and emits it from the chat completion response, confirming EOF before that response is incomplete.
- Proof gap: validation did not force a live Ollama daemon to truncate mid-stream; the producer error and provider classification are covered directly.

AI assistance: Codex performed maintainer review, upstream contract inspection, regression-proof selection, and landing preparation.
